prompt: Students revise for a test, then one group sleeps well and the other stays up all night. What does research generally find the next day?

options.text: Both groups remember exactly the same
The well-slept group usually remembers more
Sleep has no effect on memory at all

explanation: Sleep helps the brain consolidate memories formed during the day, so a good night's sleep after studying usually beats an all-night session.
